mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.meal_date, m.meal_type, m.note, i.position_no, i.amount, f.food_code AS item_food_code, f.food_name AS item_food_name, f.basis_amount AS item_basis_amount, f.basis_unit AS item_basis_unit, f.calories AS item_calories, f.protein AS item_protein, f.carbs AS item_carbs, f.fat AS item_fat FROM meals m LEFT JOIN meal_items i ON i.meal_id = m.id LEFT JOIN foods f ON f.food_code = i.food_code
mapper.select: WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.id = #{id} ORDER BY i.position_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meals (id, user_id, meal_date, meal_type, note) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{date}, #{type}, #{note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM meals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
